LanguageData.WotF_Equipment.Gizmo.NoSavedSpell: The spellbook has no saved spell yet.
LanguageData.WotF_Equipment.Reason.TwoHandedShieldBlo: A worn shield belt blocks casting with a two-handed spell staff.
LanguageData.WotF_Enchant.Gizmo.Desc: Mithril holds two inscribed spells. Switch which one fires its reaction.
